A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] served as the '''quartermaster''' of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], the intelligence service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Intelligence Quartermaster appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Advanced Class trainer for the Imperial Agent class, wherein players were sent to him by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Vasil Dorne]] in order to learn the skills of either an [[Operative combat specialization program|Operative]] or a [[Sniper combat specialization program|Sniper]]. He was removed in Game Update 5.0, when advanced classes were made available on character creation rather than level 10.<ref name="TOR" />
